Name: Strawberry Milk (Json Assets)
Author: wildskies
Description: This is a Json Assets mod that adds a recipe for Strawberry Milk to the game. The recipe can be purchased from Gus. The model for it is a recolor for andiluxe's mod that you can find here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2494]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2494[/url]
